name: Tavish Hull
source_profile:
Tavish Hull (CG) — Dock Foreman and Labor Advocate

Tavish is an experienced dockworker who has spent much of his adult life loading cargo, repairing river vessels, and supervising labor gangs along the Lower Quays. A capable organizer with a rough manner and considerable personal charm, he is widely respected among Westbridge's sailors, warehouse laborers, and freight handlers.

The rapid expansion of commercial shipping has created considerable demand for dockworkers, but wages and working conditions remain inconsistent. Accidents involving falling cargo, unstable gangplanks, and overloaded vessels are common, while employers frequently dismiss injured laborers without compensation.

Tavish has helped organize informal mutual-aid collections and has become an outspoken advocate for fair wages, safer working conditions, and reliable compensation for injured workers. His efforts have earned him the gratitude of many laborers, although wealthy merchants increasingly regard his public meetings as a threat to the uninterrupted movement of cargo.
